literal: On jimao day displayed armor and weapons used by Taizu and Taizong to Prince of Yan Yanxi, instructing him on the hardship of founding and campaigning.
idiomatic: On jimao day armor and weapons used by Taizu and Taizong were displayed to Prince of Yan Yanxi, instructing him on the hardship of founding and campaigning.

literal: On xinsi day summoned the Southern Court chancellor to discuss state affairs.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the Southern Court chancellor was summoned to discuss state affairs.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on yiyou new moon, associate privy commissioner Dou Jingyong administrator of Privy Council affairs.
idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the tenth winter month associate privy commissioner Dou Jingyong was made administrator of Privy Council affairs.

literal: On bingxu day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingxu day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

literal: On dinghai day, because Xia State king Li Bingchang died, dispatched envoys to inform his son Qianshun to administer state affairs.
idiomatic: On dinghai day, because Xia State king Li Bingchang died, envoys were dispatched to inform his son Qianshun to administer state affairs.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu day performed the rebirth ritual for Prince of Yan Yanxi; partial amnesty for prisoners at the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the eleventh month the rebirth ritual was performed for Prince of Yan Yanxi; partial amnesty for prisoners at the Supreme Capital.

literal: On wuyin day Goryeo dispatched envoys to thank for the investiture.
idiomatic: On wuyin day Goryeo sent envoys to thank for the investiture.

literal: On guimao day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Qian, Xian, Cheng, and Yi prefectures.
idiomatic: On guimao day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Qian, Xian, Cheng, and Yi prefectures.

literal: Twelfth month, on xinmao day Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the twelfth month Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

literal: On jihai day Xia State king Li Qianshun dispatched envoys presenting his father's bequeathed goods.
idiomatic: On jihai day Xia State king Li Qianshun sent envoys presenting his father's bequeathed goods.
